rev: LLC-1 (REV 11/2023), with the Submission Cover Sheet (REV 03/2024)
notes: The paper Form LLC-1 with the Secretary of State's submission cover sheet (page 1). Addresses 'street, City, CA ZIP'; initial_mailing_address 'Same' leaves item 2b blank. agent_for_service is the individual agent's full name (split into first, middle and last, with agent_address as the California street address), or 'Corporation: <registered corporate agent's name>' for item 3c (then agent_address stays blank). management_structure ticks one of the three item 4 boxes. Item 5, the purpose statement, is printed and is never altered. The organizer signs by hand; the cover sheet's comments are left blank. The page footer reads '2023 California Secretary of State' with no stated limit on copying the form.

lines.en: Contact person for this submission: first and last name
lines.zh: 本次提交的联系人：名和姓

lines.en: Limited liability company name (must include LLC or L.L.C.)
lines.zh: 有限责任公司名称（须含 LLC 或 L.L.C.）

lines.en: Initial street address of the principal office (not a P.O. box)
lines.zh: 主要办公室的初始街道地址（不可用邮政信箱）

lines.en: Initial mailing address of the LLC, if different (or "Same")
lines.zh: LLC 的初始邮寄地址（如不同；相同则填 "Same"）

lines.en: Agent for service of process: the individual's full name, or "Corporation: " and the registered corporate agent's name
lines.zh: 法律文书送达代理人：个人全名，或填写 "Corporation: " 加注册公司代理人名称

lines.en: Individual agent's California street address (not a P.O. box)
lines.zh: 个人代理人在加州的街道地址（不可用邮政信箱）

lines.en: The LLC will be managed by
Purpose statement (printed: any lawful act or activity under the California Revised Uniform LLC Act)
lines.zh: 经营目的声明（已印好：依《加州修订统一有限责任公司法》从事任何合法活动）

unmapped.purpose_statement: Printed on the form and never altered: there is nothing to fill.

entity_name.text: 1. Limited Liability Company Name (Must contain an LLC identifier such as LLC or L.L.C.  “LLC” will be added, if not included.)

designated_office_ca.text: a. Initial Street Address of Principal Office - Do not enter a P.O. Box

initial_mailing_address.text: b Initial Mailing Address of LLC if different than item 2a
